papers.title_zh: 高龄多次接种人群中的免疫印记抗体应答：JN.1/KP.2 二价更新疫苗可诱导对 JN.1 谱系变异株的高效中和，但对 BA.3.2.2 中和较弱且半衰期差异提示原始株印记
papers.title_en: Mitigation of imprinted antibody responses against COVID-19 in highly vaccinated older adults.
papers.authors: Morse RB, Egan DJS, Cheng MTK, Altaf M, Kamelian K, Gallagher C, Gutierrez LC, Sokolova O et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Medicine, University of Cambridge, Cambridge, UK; Cambridge Institute of Therapeutic Immunology & Infectio…
papers.results: JN.1与KP.2疫苗接种对全部所研究的JN.1谱系变异株诱导高中和效力，但对BA.3.2.2滴度低2-3倍；血清中和活性在两次疫苗间隔期间衰减幅度不大；血清中和半衰期：Wu-1为179天，JN.1亚型为43.7-70.1天，BA.3.2.2为107天；KP.2疫苗接种后针对全长Wu-1刺突的中和无提升，而全部JN.1后代及BA.3.2.2均出现显著提升
papers.authors_conclusion: 在老年人群中，通过每年两次、更新毒株的加强疫苗可以实现针对近期关注变异株的保护性中和抗体应答，并减轻免疫印记与抗体衰减；针对原始株的印记抗体对BA.3.2.2等高度免疫逃逸变异株的保护可能仍有意义，提示仍需对人群COVID-19体液免疫进行细致刻画
papers.ai_note: 单臂小样本（n=43）、无未接种或未更新疫苗接种的平行对照，半衰期由有限时点拟合且未报告拟合的不确定度（CI），'衰减幅度不大'为定性描述；主要读数为中和抗体替代终点，无临床结局；BA.3.2.2为非当前流行的高度突变株，其结论具推测性；文中以'部分缓解免疫印记'作为主要卖点，同时承认对Wu-1绝对滴度仍最高，解释上存在选择性强调倾向；与胸科肿瘤临床无直接关联。

pico.p: 43名高龄成年人（中位年龄85岁，IQR 75-88，女性40%），均已多次接种COVID-19疫苗
pico.ic: 间隔6个月的JN.1与KP.2株更新疫苗接种；以假病毒及替代病毒中和试验检测对Wu-1、JN.1谱系亚型及BA.3.2.2的中和滴度，同一受试者内比较接种前后及不同变异株间应答（无未接种对照）

papers.reason: 为老年人群更新株疫苗接种后的中和抗体广度与半衰期提供量化基线（Wu-1 179天 vs JN.1亚型43.7-70.1天），可作为免疫衰老与疫苗策略研究的对照参照；对胸科肿瘤诊疗决策无直接影响。
papers.abstract_en: Despite higher clinical risk of severe COVID-19, contemporary data on antibody durability and breadth in older adults receiving multiple COVID-19 booster vaccines remain limited amid ongoing evolution of SARS-CoV-2 Omicron JN.1 descendants and the divergent BA.3.2 saltation variant. We studied a clinically vulnerable cohort of 43 older adults (median age = 85 years, IQR 75-88, 40% female). Using pseudotyped and surrogate virus neutralization-based assays, we demonstrate that JN.1 and KP.2 vaccinations six months apart elicit high-potency neutralization across all studied JN.1-lineage variants but not BA.3.2.2, where titers were 2-3-fold lower. Waning of serum neutralizing activity was modest between vaccine doses, suggesting sustained immunity. Importantly, the half-life of serum neutralization against Wu-1 (179 days) was substantially longer than JN.1 subvariants (43.7-70.1 days), consistent with Wu-1-specific imprinted responses. Furthermore, BA.3.2.2 neutralizing antibody half-life was prolonged at 107 days, implicating imprinted ancestral variant-targeting antibodies having some activity against BA.3.2.2. While absolute neutralization titers remained highest against ancestral Wu-1 due to multiple historical exposures, recall responses after the KP.2 vaccine revealed a shift in immunodominance. Neutralization against full-length Wu-1 spike was not boosted, whereas all JN.1 descendants and BA.3.2.2 showed significant boosts, indicating partial alleviation of immune imprinting. These data indicate that in the elderly, protective neutralizing antibody responses against recent variants of concern can be achieved, with reduction of immune imprinting and waning through biannual, strain-updated booster vaccines. Imprinted antibodies against ancestral variants may still be relevant for protection against highly immune evasive variants such as BA.3.2.2, highlighting that careful characterization of population-level COVID-19 humoral immunity remains warranted.

papers.title_zh: 基于血液转录组的衰老时钟：以健康分子衰老轨迹量化COVID-19等疾病所致偏离（COVID-19平均年龄加速9.34年，恢复期回落）
papers.title_en: A blood aging clock defines disease-induced deviation from healthy molecular aging.
papers.authors: Li H, Liu S, Zhou Z, Lu Q, Wang G, Zhu Z, Li X
papers.affiliation_highlight: State Key Laboratory of Natural Medicines, China Pharmaceutical University, 639 Longmian Avenue, Jiangning District, Nan…
papers.results: COVID-19患者经队列特异性基线校正后平均AgeAccel为9.34年；该偏离见于各年龄组；纵向分析显示AgeAccel在急性感染期升高、恢复期下降；脓毒症、流感与重性抑郁障碍中AgeAccel亦升高。摘要未报告AgeAccel的95%CI或P值。
papers.authors_conclusion: 研究将转录组AgeAccel重新定义为疾病诱导的、偏离健康分子稳态的可解释性度量，并为从外周血转录组评估全身疾病负荷与恢复动态提供定量框架；作者称恢复期回落提示队列层面存在潜在可逆的“类衰老”分子状态而非不可逆衰老。
papers.ai_note: 主要结果仅有单一均值（9.34年），无置信区间、无P值、无效应量对比，统计不确定性无法评估；“队列特异性基线校正”与AgeAccel本身高度耦合，可能吸收批次/队列效应，使加速量估计依赖于校正方式；恢复期回落为队列层面（非个体配对）观察，无法排除构成变化或采样时点差异；未报告AgeAccel与疾病严重度、临床结局的关联，临床可用性未验证；跨病种（含MDD）扩展削弱“呼吸/感染性疾病”特异性，且各病种样本量与效应未列；与胸部肿瘤、胸外科决策无直接关联。

pico.p: 23个队列共10 753份全血转录组谱；其中5808名健康个体用于构建健康血液分子衰老参考轨迹；COVID-19患者（摘要未给出例数），并扩展至脓毒症、流感、重性抑郁障碍
pico.ic: 血液衰老预测模型BAP（blood aging predictor）计算的转录组年龄加速（AgeAccel）对比健康衰老参考轨迹；COVID-19急性期与恢复期的纵向比较；脓毒症/流感/MDD的跨病种比较

papers.reason: 提供了一套可复用的“健康分子衰老参考轨迹+偏差量化”分析范式与大体量全血转录组整合基线，可供胸部肿瘤围手术期/治疗后外周血分子负荷与“类衰老”状态研究作为方法学对照与参照；对胸外科手术选择、结节判断或肿瘤治疗决策无直接影响。
papers.abstract_en: Aging shapes disease susceptibility and recovery, yet it remains unclear whether disease-induced molecular perturbations can be quantitatively mapped onto healthy aging trajectories. Here, we integrated 10 753 whole-blood transcriptomic profiles from 23 cohorts and developed a blood aging predictor (BAP) using 5808 healthy individuals to define a reference trajectory of blood molecular aging. Applying BAP to COVID-19 revealed marked transcriptomic age acceleration (AgeAccel), with patients showing an average AgeAccel of 9.34 years after cohort-specific baseline correction. This aging-referenced deviation occurred across age groups and was associated with interferon signaling, immune-inflammatory activation, cytokine and neutrophil-related programs, DNA damage responses, proteostasis stress, and impaired cellular quality-control pathways. Longitudinal analysis showed that AgeAccel increased during acute infection but declined during recovery, indicating a potentially reversible aging-like molecular state at the cohort level rather than irreversible aging. Extension to sepsis, influenza, and major depressive disorder further demonstrated that elevated AgeAccel captures disease-associated molecular burden across distinct pathological contexts. Together, our study redefines transcriptomic AgeAccel as an interpretable measure of disease-induced deviation from healthy molecular homeostasis and provides a quantitative framework for assessing systemic disease burden and recovery dynamics from peripheral blood transcriptomes.

papers.abstract_en: Ultrafine particles (UFPs, ≤100 nm) dominate atmospheric particle number concentrations and contribute substantially to human inhalation exposure. Accurate prediction of their respiratory deposition requires accounting for hygroscopic growth under the warm and humid conditions of the human respiratory tract. However, the hygroscopic behavior of nanometer-sized particles is strongly influenced by the Kelvin effect, which elevates deliquescence relative humidity (DRH) and suppresses water uptake, potentially introducing uncertainty into deposition estimates. In this study, hygroscopic growth factors (HGFs) and DRH of 15-100 nm sodium chloride (NaCl) particles were measured using a Hygroscopic Tandem Differential Mobility Analyzer (HTDMA) and incorporated into the Multiple-Path Particle Dosimetry (MPPD) model to quantify the influence of size-dependent hygroscopic growth on respiratory deposition. Smaller particles (15-36 nm) exhibited elevated DRH (77-81%) and reduced hygroscopic growth compared with larger particles. At relative humidity (RH) of 80-90%, HGFs ranged from 1.95-2.25 for 15 nm particles and 1.99-2.36 for 100 nm particles. Incorporating experimentally determined hygroscopic growth significantly altered predicted deposition. Neglecting hygroscopic growth overestimated total deposition by up to 25%, with regional differences reaching 18% in the tracheobronchial region for particles ≤ 50 nm. Hygroscopic growth also redistributed deposition toward deeper lung regions for larger ultrafine particles, whereas smaller particles remained dominated by diffusion and preferentially deposited in proximal airways. These findings demonstrate that experimentally constrained hygroscopic growth measurements improve respiratory deposition estimates for hygroscopic ultrafine particles and provide benchmark data for inhalation exposure assessment and future studies of chemically complex atmospheric aerosols.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Papua New Guinea (PNG) is a high burden country for multidrug-resistant TB (MDR-TB). Contemporary data is needed given the introduction of a new MDR-TB treatment regimen. We aimed to describe the epidemiology of MDR-TB from 2022 to 2023 and evaluate the performance of the Xpert MTB/XDR assay in PNG. METHODS: Molecular testing was conducted at district/provincial laboratories and the Central Public Health Laboratory (CPHL), and phenotypic drug susceptibility testing (DST) at the Queensland Mycobacterium Reference Laboratory. We included cases with Xpert MTB/RIF Ultra and MTB/XDR results to describe the epidemiology of MDR-TB. Specimens with Xpert MTB/XDR and phenotypic DST results were used to evaluate the performance of molecular testing modalities compared to phenotypic DST. RESULTS: 206 MDR-TB and 20 pre-XDR-TB diagnostic cases were included, predominantly from Western Province (111, 49%; 18.5 referred cases/100,000 population/year) and National Capital District (86, 38%; 5.7 referred cases/100,000 population/year). The most common risk factor was MDR-TB exposure (67/226, 30%). The Xpert MTB/XDR assay showed high sensitivity and specificity for isoniazid and fluoroquinolone resistance. DISCUSSION: PNG continues to have a remarkably high incidence of MDR-TB. Risk factor data highlights the importance of contact management. Despite challenges, molecular diagnostics perform well and can improve MDR-TB detection.

papers.abstract_en: Type VII toxin-antitoxin (TA) systems neutralize toxins through antitoxin-mediated post-translational modification (PTM), with the oligoAMPylation-based HepT/MntA and phosphorylation-based AbiE systems representing the most prevalent families. Although the AbiE TA system from Mycobacterium tuberculosis is known to employ antitoxin-dependent phosphorylation to antagonize its toxin, the overall distribution and regulatory diversity of AbiE-like systems remain obscure. A comprehensive search of the IMG/M database revealed that AbiE TA systems comprise a conserved toxin family paired with six distinct groups of antitoxins, including four newly identified antitoxin groups. Despite extensive sequence divergence, structural predictions indicate that most of these antitoxins share a conserved winged helix-turn-helix (wHTH) domain and a C-terminal structurally homologous domain (CTD). We further demonstrate a unifying antagonistic mechanism across these diverse systems: cognate antitoxins induce the phosphorylation of conserved serine or threonine residues in their partner toxins, resulting in toxin inactivation in a CTD-dependent manner. Structural analyses reveal that the antitoxin CTD exhibits homology to nucleotidyltransferases (NTases), including the AbiE toxin itself and the MntA antitoxins, suggesting that type VII antitoxins may have evolved from an ancestral NTase superfamily. Moreover, their DNA-binding capabilities are also diverse, with some functioning as transcriptional regulators and others lacking detectable DNA-binding activity. Collectively, this study expands the recognized diversity of type VII TA systems that rely on PTM for antagonism and provides new insights into their evolutionary trajectories.

papers.abstract_en: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is closely associated with biomass fuel (BMF) exposure. Biomass-related PM2.5 (BRPM2.5), a fine particulate component of BMF smoke, may contribute to BMF-associated pulmonary inflammation, but the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. This study investigated the role of the FOXM1/lncRNA COPD-R axis in BRPM2.5-induced pulmonary inflammatory responses. A BMF-induced COPD rat model was established, followed by lung tissue RNA sequencing. Rat L2 cells were treated with lncRNA COPD-R knockdown or overexpression with or without BRPM2.5 exposure. qPCR, FISH, Western blotting, ELISA, ChIP, and dual-luciferase reporter assays were performed to assess lncRNA COPD-R expression, localization, inflammatory responses and transcriptional regulation. After 7 months of BMF exposure in rats, 312 differentially expressed lncRNAs were identified, including 294 upregulated and 18 downregulated transcripts. lncRNA COPD-R expression increased from 0.1505 ± 0.04259 in controls to 1.054 ± 0.2983 in the BMF group (P < 0.01). RNA sequencing of L2 cells following lncRNA COPD-R knockdown revealed enrichment of differentially expressed genes in the IL-17 and other inflammatory signaling pathways. Transcription factor prediction, ChIP and dual-luciferase assays supported FOXM1-mediated transcriptional regulation of lncRNA COPD-R through promoter binding. BRPM2.5 increased lncRNA COPD-R expression, whereas lncRNA COPD-R knockdown reduced BRPM2.5-induced CCL2, IL-17F, MMP-9 and TIMP-1 expression. FOXM1 knockdown or overexpression affected lncRNA COPD-R expression and inflammatory responses, whereas lncRNA COPD-R overexpression rescued these effects following FOXM1 knockdown. Collectively, our findings provide new insights into the mechanisms underlying BRPM2.5-induced pulmonary inflammation and suggest that the FOXM1/lncRNA COPD-R axis may play an important role in this process.

papers.abstract_en: Nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) are clinically relevant opportunistic pathogens. However, epidemiological data on NTM in low- and middle-income countries like Ecuador remain scarce. This retrospective study characterized the species distribution of NTM identified by molecular methods in the 225 isolates processed at the "Instituto Nacional de Salud Pública e Investigación" in Ecuador from 2019 to 2024. Most isolates were recovered from pulmonary samples (205/225; 91.11%). Their geographic distribution was heterogeneous, with the highest numbers recorded in El Oro, Pichincha, and Los Ríos. However, because all isolates were processed at a single national reference laboratory, this distribution may reflect referral patterns and access to laboratory services. It should not be interpreted as representative of Ecuador's national NTM epidemiology. Overall, 11 different NTM species were identified, with M. fortuitum, M. intracellulare, M. kansasii, and M. abscessus predominating in pulmonary isolates, while M. fortuitum and M. abscessus predominated in extrapulmonary isolates. The relatively small number of NTM isolates identified over the six-year study period, together with the scarcity of national data, suggests that NTM infections may be underdiagnosed in Ecuador. Strengthening surveillance and diagnostic capacity for NTM in Ecuador is strongly recommended.

papers.abstract_en: Complement activation-related pseudoallergy (CARPA) describes a proposed non-IgE-mediated hypersensitivity mechanism in which complement activation contributes causally, often through generation of the anaphylatoxins C3a and C5a. These mediators may activate responsive effector cells and contribute to systemic inflammatory responses that clinically resemble anaphylaxis. Complement activation and complement-associated immediate reactions have been reported with several therapeutic agents and drug-delivery systems, including micelle-solubilized formulations, liposomal drugs, nanoparticle-based therapeutics, PEGylated agents, and biologic therapies; however, the strength of causal evidence varies among products. Importantly, reactions may be driven not only by the active pharmaceutical ingredient but also by formulation components, such as surfactants, solubilizing agents, lipid carriers, and other drug vehicles. As compounded injectable therapies, including intralesional dutasteride, become increasingly used in dermatology, clinicians should recognize that formulation vehicles vary among manufacturers and compounding pharmacies. Certain formulations may contain complement-activating excipients, such as Cremophor EL (polyoxyethylated castor oil), which has been implicated in immediate pseudoallergic reactions. Although CARPA has been widely discussed in oncology, immunology, and nanomedicine, its relevance to a broader range of infusion and injectable therapies remains underrecognized. This narrative review summarizes the mechanisms, clinical features, drug classes, and formulation-related risk factors associated with complement activation and complement-associated reactions, with particular attention to injectables and compounded therapies. Greater awareness of complement-activating formulations may help recognize pseudoallergic reactions, evaluate excipients more carefully, and improve the safe administration of infusion and injectable therapies.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: Syphilis during pregnancy represents a significant public health issue in the U.S., leading to rising rates of congenital syphilis and preventable adverse outcomes such as stillbirth and miscarriage. However, the understanding of syphilis screening/testing among pregnancies ending in stillbirth and miscarriage is limited. The purpose of this study was to analyze the monthly trends of syphilis screening/tetsing among pregnancies ending in stillbirth and miscarriage. METHODS: A retrospective longitudinal study was conducted using the Marketscan® Commercial Claims and Encounters Database from 2015 to 2024. To identify pregnancies ending in stillbirth and miscarriage, validated ICD-10, CPT-4, and HCPCS codes were used. Monthly syphilis screening/testing rates were identified and summarized at any point during the prenatal care and at delivery, stratified by age, region, and urban/rural residence. Temporal trends were assessed using generalized linear mixed models with a Poisson distribution. RESULTS: Syphilis screening/testing among pregnancies ending in stillbirth remained stable, with no notable changes. Prenatal syphilis screening ranged from 72% to 90%, while at-delivery testing ranged from 5% to 15%. Testing during the at-delivery window was higher in the South and lower in rural areas. Syphilis screening/tetsing among pregnancies ending in miscarriage was consistently low. CONCLUSION: Syphilis screening/testing among pregnancies ending in stillbirth and miscarriage remains insufficient, with no improvement over time. Ongoing gaps and disparities in screening/testing may contribute to preventable adverse outcomes. A deeper understanding of the ongoing low screening/testing rates and disparities is needed to support the development of more focused and effective strategies to improve syphilis screening coverage.

papers.abstract_en: DNA-protein crosslinks (DPCs) are one of the most complex and deleterious forms of DNA damage. DPCs arise from the stabilization of covalent enzyme-DNA intermediates, such as topoisomerase cleavage complexes, or from exposure to bifunctional crosslinking agents, and they differ in protein identity, DNA context and chemical linkage. Because of their bulky nature, DPCs obstruct essential chromatin processes such as DNA replication and transcription, making their timely removal by dedicated DPC repair pathways crucial for genome stability and cellular homeostasis. In this Review, we discuss the origin and properties of the major classes of DPCs. We also describe key enzymes involved in DPC repair, with a particular focus on the proteasome and the specialized DPC protease SPRTN. Next, we synthesize recent advances in the understanding of proteolytic DPC repair across replication-coupled, transcription-coupled and global genome repair pathways and explain how these pathways converge on ubiquitylation of the crosslinked protein to license proteolysis by the proteasome or SPRTN. Finally, we discuss how defective DPC proteolysis contributes to genome instability, premature ageing and cancer predisposition.

papers.authors: Sun N, Han X, Li W, Zhang B, Dong X, Lei M, Yang Y, Zhang Y et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: State Key Laboratory of Information Photonics and Optical Communications, School of Physical Science and Technology, Bei…
papers.results: 在 (MnFeCoNi)1-xCdxPS3 单晶中观察到电场诱导极性态；在 ±0.5 V 实现类铁电翻转；转变温度最高 523 K；观察到长时程增强与双向权重调制。
papers.authors_conclusion: This work establishes high-entropy engineering as a strategy for manipulating ion migration dynamics in two-dimensional layered materials, opening a pathway toward emergent ferroelectric-like states beyond the conventional requirement of non-centrosymmetric structures.
papers.ai_note: 本文非胸科肿瘤研究，无人群、样本量、对照、统计检验与效应量信息；所述“ferroelectric-like”由电场驱动 Cd2+ 迁移产生，并非本征铁电，摘要中的类铁电表述外推至铁电器件需谨慎；未报告器件一致性、耐久性、保持时间等统计。

papers.abstract_en: Two-dimensional ferroelectric materials offer opportunities for ultrathin non-volatile electronics, but their development is limited by stringent structural requirements for intrinsic polarity. Here we show that high-entropy engineering can induce switchable polarization in centrosymmetric van der Waals materials. By introducing configurational disorder into layered metal phosphorus trisulfides, we synthesize (MnFeCoNi)1-xCdxPS3 single crystals exhibiting electric-field-induced polar states and ferroelectric-like switching at ±0.5 V, with a transition temperature up to 523 K. Combined calculations and characterizations reveal that polarization originates from electric-field-driven Cd2+ migration enabled by lattice distortions and heterogeneous coordination environments. This migration-mediated mechanism differs from conventional ferroelectric models and enables non-volatile neuromorphic functions, including long-term potentiation and bidirectional weight modulation. This work establishes high-entropy engineering as a strategy for manipulating ion migration dynamics in two-dimensional layered materials, opening a pathway toward emergent ferroelectric-like states beyond the conventional requirement of non-centrosymmetric structures.

papers.abstract_en: β-Lactams and macrolides are two cornerstone classes of antimicrobials in clinical practice. Traditionally, this combination was considered potentially antagonistic. However, accumulating evidence from basic and clinical research has begun to challenge this view and indicates that the two classes may exert complementary and synergistic effects in specific clinical contexts. This review first describes the mechanisms of action and resistance of both antibiotic classes, and then presents clinical evidence supporting the use of combination therapy. The greatest clinical benefit of combination therapy is observed in adults with severe community-acquired pneumonia (CAP). By contrast, results from non-severe CAP or pediatric populations have been inconsistent. We then systematically review potential synergistic mechanisms, including complementary antibacterial targets, macrolide penetration facilitated by β-lactam-induced cell-wall injury, suppression of bacterial repair and stress responses, biofilm disruption, immunomodulation, and quorum-sensing interference. We also classify the strength of evidence for each proposed mechanism. Finally, we compare the pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) profiles of azithromycin, clarithromycin, and erythromycin and assess their potential impact on combination efficacy. We also discuss safety concerns, including adverse effects, drug interactions, and selection for resistance, along with strategies to address these issues. It should be emphasized that most mechanistic evidence derives from in vitro or animal studies, and only a minority comes from clinical research. The combination should be used with strict attention to indications, and its benefits should not be extrapolated indiscriminately to other conditions. We conclude that β-lactam-macrolide combination therapy demonstrates promising synergy in severe CAP and other specific infections. The multi-level mechanistic framework lends biological plausibility to the observed synergy, but biological synergy does not guarantee clinical benefit in all patients. Only when used in the right patients, at the right time, and with the right drug combination can this therapeutic strategy produce clinical benefit.

papers.title_zh: 喀麦隆盘尾丝虫病伊维菌素大规模给药覆盖率（2000–2025）：系统评价与荟萃分析显示标化调查覆盖率67.3%，且项目上报覆盖率系统性高于调查估计
papers.title_en: Ivermectin Mass Drug Administration Coverage Against Onchocerciasis in Cameroon, 2000-2025: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
papers.authors: Nditanchou R, Minkat TMM, Djeunga HCN, Selby R, Kamgno J, Verhoeven V, Colebunders R, Fodjo JNS et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Sightsavers Cameroon Country Office, Immeuble No 1067 bis Rue 1750 Nouvelle Route Bastos, P.O.
papers.results: 标化调查覆盖率均值66.5%（范围32.0–88.3%）；45/116（38.8%）观察低于65%推荐阈值；97/98配对观察中项目上报覆盖率高于调查估计，平均高出21.7个百分点；合并覆盖率为67.3%（95%CI 65.0–69.5%；I²=98.5%；预测区间40.6–86.1%），聚类稳健95%CI为56.8–76.3%；五年依从性24%–67%，系统性不服药6.8%–35%；微丝蚴流行率较基线下降52%至95%，最新报告的CDTI后流行率0%–47.0%
papers.authors_conclusion: 喀麦隆伊维菌素MDA覆盖率高度异质，与感染流行率变化相呼应；项目上报覆盖率持续高于基于调查的估计；覆盖缺口反映情境特异的操作性与社区接受度障碍。因此消除监测应三角验证基于调查的覆盖率与依从性、当地实施障碍及传播指标，以指导有针对性的项目改进与盘尾丝虫病消除决策。
papers.ai_note: ①异质性极高（I²=98.5%），预测区间40.6–86.1%横跨65%阈值两侧，合并点估计的决策价值有限；且传统95%CI（65.0–69.5%）与聚类稳健CI（56.8–76.3%）差异明显，提示存在聚类内相关，摘要并列报告易被误读为精度很高。②“微丝蚴流行率较基线下降52%–95%”为无对照的前后描述，且方向表述含混（是降幅区间还是残余范围需查原文），不能归因于MDA。③“项目上报高于调查估计21.7个百分点”是本文最有价值的方法学信号，但属描述性配对比较，未做正式检验或校正。④主要合成对象是覆盖率这一过程指标，非健康结局，摘要结论以“消除决策”落点，存在从过程指标外推至消除判定的落差。⑤与本刊胸科/肿瘤业务无实质关联。

pico.p: 2000–2025年发表的32项研究/报告，其中20个独立来源贡献116个区县-年覆盖率观察；人群为喀麦隆盘尾丝虫病流行区接受伊维菌素大规模给药的人群
pico.ic: 干预：伊维菌素大规模给药（MDA）；对照：无平行对照，为单臂覆盖率合成，以65%推荐覆盖阈值为参照；同时描述服药依从性与治疗障碍

papers.reason: 该研究不涉及胸部肿瘤或呼吸系统疾病，对胸科临床判断无直接影响；其可借鉴之处仅在于方法学层面——展示了项目自报数据与独立调查数据之间的系统性偏倚（约21.7个百分点）以及聚类稳健推断与常规随机效应CI的差异，可作为评估登记数据库/项目报表类真实世界数据可信度的对照范例。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Persistent onchocerciasis transmission has been documented in some Cameroonian foci despite long-term ivermectin mass drug administration (MDA). We synthesized treatment coverage, adherence and determinants. METHODS: We systematically reviewed seven databases and grey literature (2000-2025). District-year coverage observations were standardized to total-population epidemiological coverage and pooled using logit-transformed random-effects meta-analysis with Restricted Maximum Likelihood estimation and study/district cluster-robust inference. Adherence, infection prevalence and barriers to treatment were described separately. RESULTS: Thirty-two studies/reports were included among which 20 independent sources contributed 116 observations to the primary meta-analysis. Standardized survey coverage averaged 66.5% (range 32.0-88.3%); 45/116 (38.8%) observations were below the 65% recommendation. Programme-reported coverage exceeded survey estimates in 97/98 paired observations by a mean 21.7 percentage points. Pooled coverage was 67.3% (95% CI 65.0-69.5%; I²=98.5%; prediction interval 40.6-86.1%); the cluster-robust 95% CI was 56.8-76.3%. Five-year adherence ranged from 24% to 67%, while systematic non-adherence ranged from 6.8% to 35% across reported settings. Qualitative synthesis identified setting-specific combinations of missed contact, absence, distribution failures, refusal or hesitancy, adverse-effect concerns, information and trust barriers, mobility and temporary ineligibility. Microfilarial prevalence declined substantially from baseline (52% to 95%) but remained highly heterogeneous across long-treated settings, with the latest reported post-CDTI prevalence ranging from 0% to 47.0%. CONCLUSIONS: Ivermectin mass drug administration (MDA) coverage in Cameroon was highly heterogeneous, mirroring variations in infection prevalence. Programme-reported coverage consistently exceeded survey-based estimates. Coverage gaps reflected context-specific operational and community acceptance barriers. Elimination monitoring should therefore triangulate survey-based coverage and adherence, local delivery barriers, and transmission indicators to guide targeted programme improvements and onchocerciasis elimination decisions.

papers.title_en: EvoGraph: synergizing evolutionary semantics and tail-aware graph contrastive learning for protein-protein interaction prediction.
papers.authors: Zhang Y, Zhao Y, Zhou J, Wang H, Wu C
papers.affiliation_highlight: College of Computer Science and Technology, National University of Defense Technology, No.
papers.authors_conclusion: EvoGraph在四个基准数据集上显著优于最先进基线，在识别尾部交互类型方面取得显著提升且不损害总体性能。

papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of multilabel protein-protein interactions is pivotal for deciphering molecular mechanisms and accelerating drug discovery. However, existing methods are often hindered by the inherent long-tailed distribution of interaction types, leading to poor generalization on rare but biologically critical categories. To address this challenge, we propose EvoGraph, a novel framework that synergizes deep evolutionary semantics with tail-aware graph representation learning. Specifically, EvoGraph first leverages the pretrained protein language model to establish a semantic foundation, compensating for sparse signals in rare classes. Driven by the critical need to disentangle complex interaction types and mitigate head-class dominance, we integrate two core mechanisms. To resolve the structural heterogeneity of diverse interaction types, we design a multi-view graph neural network encoder that aggregates type-specific topological contexts. Simultaneously, to counter label imbalance, we introduce a tail-aware contrastive learning module, which regularizes the latent space by clustering minority samples, effectively preventing them from being overshadowed by head classes. Finally, these features are synthesized via a hybrid fusion strategy and optimized with an asymmetric loss. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that EvoGraph significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving substantial improvements in identifying tail interaction types without compromising overall performance. The implementation of EvoGraph is available at https://github.com/AlphaZYL/EvoGraph.

papers.title_zh: 跨任务基准测试显示深度学习模型在不同类型分子数量性状位点间的可迁移性差异显著
papers.title_en: Cross-task benchmarking reveals variable transferability of deep learning models across molecular quantitative trait loci.
papers.authors: Chen S, Wang X, Peleg AY, Xu S, Li F, Webb GI, Song J
papers.affiliation_highlight: Monash Biomedicine Discovery Institute and Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, Monash University, Wellingt…
papers.results: 所有模型在eQTL预测中表现良好，但在其他xQTL预测中性能差异显著；染色质可及性、转录因子结合与组蛋白QTL一般预测良好，染色质环化与microRNA表达QTL仍具挑战；AlphaGenome与Borzoi在类别不平衡情形下表现更稳健；将AlphaGenome与Borzoi应用于冠状动脉疾病GWAS位点，识别出337个高置信候选染色质可及性QTL，其中11个为既往报道、326个为预测染色质可及性信号等位基因特异性差异显著更大的新候选
papers.authors_conclusion: 当前以eQTL为中心的模型跨任务性能存在显著差异，长程基因组表征具优势，可据此指导复杂疾病候选调控变异的优先级排序
papers.ai_note: 全文为计算基准测试，摘要未给出任何性能指标数值（相关性、AUROC等）与置信区间/统计检验，模型优劣结论仅有定性描述；'337个高置信候选'为预测结果而非实验验证，其中326个的依据是预测信号等位基因差异，属计算证据强度；摘要突出基础模型优势与下游候选发现，但未量化跨任务性能下降幅度，模型间比较是否经统计检验信息不足

pico.p: 九类分子数量性状位点（xQTL）预测任务；另在冠状动脉疾病GWAS位点上做应用验证；样本量摘要未报告
pico.ic: 六种代表性深度学习模型（序列型与注释型，含基础模型AlphaGenome、Borzoi）的预训练调控特征跨任务迁移；对照为基于局部序列上下文模型及树集成分类器增强

papers.reason: 提供深度学习调控变异模型跨分子表型迁移性的对照基准，可作为胸科肿瘤胚系/体细胞非编码变异优先级排序工具选型的参照，并提示eQTL训练模型直接外推至其他调控表型存在风险
papers.abstract_en: Most genetic variants associated with complex traits reside in non-coding regions of the genome, complicating their functional interpretation. Recent deep learning models have advanced the prediction of expression quantitative trait loci (eQTLs), but whether these models generalize across diverse molecular phenotypes is unknown. Here, we assess the cross-task transferability of pretrained regulatory features from six representative sequence- and annotation-based models across nine classes of molecular quantitative trait loci (xQTLs). We observe that while all models perform well in eQTL prediction, their performance varies substantially across other xQTL predictions. Chromatin accessibility, transcription factor binding, and histone QTLs are generally well predicted, whereas chromatin looping and microRNA expression QTLs remain challenging. Foundation models, particularly AlphaGenome and Borzoi, consistently outperform models based on local sequence context and exhibit improved robustness across class-imbalance settings. Tree-based ensemble classifiers further enhance predictive performance, suggesting that nonlinear interactions among regulatory features contribute substantially to variant prioritization. Applying AlphaGenome and Borzoi to coronary artery disease-associated genome-wide association studies loci identifies 337 high-confidence candidate chromatin accessibility QTLs, including 11 previously reported and 326 candidates that display significantly larger allele-specific differences in predicted chromatin accessibility signals. Collectively, our results reveal substantial variability in the cross-task performance of current eQTL-centric models, highlight the advantages of long-range genomic representations and inform the prioritization of candidate regulatory variants contributing to complex diseases.

papers.title_zh: AIRQ判定为控制良好的哮喘患者中，每日使用急救药物与后续12个月急性发作风险的关系（预测队列二次分析）
papers.title_en: The Asthma Impairment and Risk Questionnaire supports the GINA goal of minimization of exacerbation risk.
papers.authors: Murphy KR, Chipps BE, Zeiger RS, Beuther DA, Wise RA, McCann WA, Reibman J, George M et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Boys Town National Research Hospital, Boys Town, Nebraska.
papers.results: 每日急救使用见于8/375例AIRQ控制良好患者（2.1%）；急救使用>4次见于21/359例（5.8%）。控制良好人群中，每日急救使用者1/375（0.3%）、急救>4次者7/359（1.9%）在后续12个月内发生急性发作。对任一损害或风险条目回答『是』且后续发生急性发作的控制良好患者数在两种评估间相似（AIRQ：55/375[14.7%]；含共识急救条目的AIRQ：52/359[14.5%]；P=.94）。
papers.authors_conclusion: 对每日急救使用回答『是』并不会使经AIRQ判定为控制良好的患者处于更高的急性发作风险中。
papers.ai_note: ① 关键暴露组事件数极少（每日急救组仅1例发作），无置信区间与预设非劣/等效界值，『不增加风险』实为效能不足的阴性观察，不足以排除风险；② 主要比较为描述性计数，P=.94来自『任一损害/风险条目回答是』这一不同构念的比例比较，与每日急救的核心问题不对应，属替代性次要比较；③ 暴露定义基于问卷自报的2周回顾，无药物客观数据；④ 该分析为预测队列的二次亚组分析，未针对本问题做样本量估算，存在选择性报告与低事件数偏倚风险。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Instruments combining asthma symptom impairment with exacerbation history could help to quantitatively measure important control domains. The composite Asthma Impairment and Risk Questionnaire (AIRQ) is a validated 10-item assessment for patients aged ≥12 years that categorizes control and predicts exacerbations better than impairment-only measures or specialty physicians. The AIRQ rescue medication question could result in patients with daily use of short-acting beta2-agonists classified as well-controlled. OBJECTIVE: Determine how a 'yes' response to using rescue daily, affects exacerbation occurrence in AIRQ-identified well-controlled patients. METHODS: Among participants in an AIRQ exacerbation prediction study, number of well-controlled patients responding 'yes' to daily rescue use in the prior 2 weeks who experienced a subsequent exacerbation over 12 months was determined. Analogous analyses were performed when the AIRQ rescue question was substituted with a consensus-based item of rescue use >4 times in the prior 2 weeks. RESULTS: Daily rescue use was reported by 8/375 AIRQ well-controlled patients (2.1%). Rescue use >4 times was reported by 21/359 well-controlled patients (5.8%) via AIRQ with the consensus-based rescue item. Among well-controlled populations, 1/375 with daily rescue use (0.3%) and 7/359 with rescue use >4 times (1.9%) in the prior 2 weeks had exacerbations. The number of well-controlled patients with subsequent exacerbations responding 'yes' to any one of the impairment or risk questions was similar between assessments (AIRQ: 55/375 [14.7%]; AIRQ with the consensus rescue item: 52/359 [14.5%]; P=.94). CONCLUSION: A "yes" response to daily rescue use does not place patients identified as well-controlled by AIRQ at increased exacerbation risk.

papers.abstract_en: Adoptive T-cell therapies using chimeric antigen receptors (CARs) or engineered T-cell receptors (TCRs) have transformed cancer treatment but remain limited by poor persistence and progressive T-cell exhaustion. Manufacturing strategies that promote memory T-cell formation may improve therapeutic durability. Here we investigated whether transient pharmacologic activation of the p53 pathway influences the differentiation and function of human CD8+ T cells. p53 expression was minimal in quiescent naïve CD8+ T cells but was rapidly induced following T-cell receptor activation. Pharmacologic inhibition of the p53 negative regulator MDM2 increased p53 protein levels and promoted expansion of central memory and stem-like memory T-cell subsets during clonal proliferation. Treated cells displayed enhanced mitochondrial fitness, increased polyfunctional cytokine production, and transcriptional programs consistent with memory differentiation and reduced exhaustion. Importantly, TCR-engineered CD8+ T cells generated in the presence of the MDM2 inhibitor Navtemadlin demonstrated superior tumor-cell killing in vitro compared with conventionally manufactured cells. These findings identify transient p53 activation as a pharmacologic strategy to enhance memory programming during T-cell manufacturing and suggest a clinically feasible approach to improve the efficacy of adoptive T-cell immunotherapies.

papers.abstract_en: Fully automated segmentation of medical images is essential for streamlining clinical workflows and improving diagnostic efficiency. However, building a single model that jointly handles multiple segmentation tasks remains challenging because different tasks may vary not only in target structures but also in heterogeneous data distributions. Existing learnable-prompt methods encode task-specific priors, but their generalization may still be constrained by cross-task interference when the tasks have substantially different data distributions. In this study, we propose Hybrid Prompt-based Segmentation, referred to as HybPromptSeg, which is a hybrid prompt-driven, encoder-decoder-based network that unifies multiple medical image segmentation tasks within a single shared model. Concretely, we introduce a Unified Hybrid Prompt (UHP) mechanism that integrates spatial-domain and Fourier-amplitude representations within a shared learnable prompt to model task- and modality-related variations. We further design a Task-conditioned Prompt Generation (TPG) module that generates discriminative task-conditioned prompts to guide the decoder for different segmentation tasks. To evaluate HybPromptSeg, we construct two benchmarks: a single-modality multi-task (SMMT) benchmark for evaluating task discrimination under shared-modality conditions, and a multi-modality multi-task (MMMT) benchmark for evaluating robustness under cross-modality variations. Experimental results demonstrate that HybPromptSeg achieves the best performance among the evaluated unified multi-task models on both benchmarks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/nnnsjtu/HybSeg.

papers.abstract_en: The CADENCE trial evaluated sotatercept in combined post- and pre-capillary pulmonary hypertension associated with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (CpcPH-HFpEF). We analyzed the pathophysiological implications of the observed pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR) reduction.A hemodynamic comparison was conducted contrasting the mechanistic effects of sotaercept with conventional pulmonary vasodilators.In CADENCE, PVR and pressure reductions occurred without marked cardiac output augmentation, contrasting with flow-mediated recruitment typical of traditional vasodilators. Sotatercept-induced PVR reduction may reflect true vascular reverse remodeling rather than vasodilation, underscoring the need to discriminate resistance reduction mechanisms in CpcPHHFpEF.

papers.abstract_en: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) is the key housekeeping enzyme necessary to generate reduced NADPH for its downstream antioxidant activity; its deficiency is the world's most common enzymopathy. Clinical symptoms of G6PD deficiency are acute hemolytic anemia and neonatal hyperbilirubinemia. Untreated hyperbilirubinemia can progress to bilirubin neurotoxicity. Data on the prevalence of G6PD deficiency and neonatal hyperbilirubinemia is scarce in Indonesia and there is a need for a nationwide association study of neonatal hyperbilirubinemia and G6PD deficiency. Indonesia started its national newborn screening implementation program in 2025. Only 46.8% of specimens received by the referral laboratories were tested, resulting in a G6PD prevalence of 0.25% in newborns. The data highlighted substantial challenges related to specimen quality, referral pathways and geographic coverage. This may underestimate the true national burden because Indonesia has a remarkably diverse ethnic group, and G6PD prevalence is very heterogeneous, where the prevalent regions coincide with malaria endemicity. These remote regions face challenges in accessing referral laboratories due to vast geographic distances. Further studies are needed to ensure that integration of G6PD screening to the NBS program is necessary, especially in G6PD prevalent regions in Indonesia.

papers.abstract_en: Rosacea is a chronic inflammatory skin disorder in which macrophages have been increasingly implicated, yet the spatial basis and local cues of their recruitment remain poorly defined. Given the prominent perifollicular inflammatory changes in rosacea, we investigated whether sebocytes contribute to macrophage recruitment and the underlying mechanisms. Multiplex immunofluorescence combined with distance-stratified quantification demonstrated a preferential perifollicular distribution of macrophages around pilosebaceous units (PSUs) in human rosacea lesions. Integrated single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomic analyses identified the C-C motif chemokine ligand 5 (CCL5)-C-C motif chemokine receptor 5 (CCR5) axis as a candidate mediator of sebocyte-macrophage crosstalk. Silencing CCL5 by small interfering RNA and CCL5 neutralization attenuated sebocyte-driven macrophage migration in vitro and reduced macrophage accumulation in vivo. Transcriptomic analysis of sebocytes further linked CCL5 expression to activation of Yes-associated protein (YAP)/activator protein-1 (AP-1) signaling. Consistently, pharmacological inhibition of YAP or AP-1 reduced CCL5 expression in sebocytes and alleviated erythema and macrophage infiltration in vivo. Furthermore, untargeted lipidomics uncovered profound metabolic reprogramming in sebocytes, characterized notably by the accumulation of cholesteryl esters. Bidirectional interventions via simvastatin and cholesterol loading confirmed that this lipid remodeling acts as an upstream driver of YAP nuclear translocation. Overall, our study identifies a PSU-centered inflammatory niche in rosacea and implicates lipid-driven, YAP/AP-1-associated sebocytic CCL5 upregulation in perifollicular macrophage recruitment, providing a rationale for further exploring sebocyte- and pilosebaceous unit-directed therapeutic strategies in rosacea.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption is a critical pathological event contributing to secondary injury and poor outcomes following traumatic brain injury (TBI). While neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) are known to exacerbate neuroinflammation, the precise molecular mechanisms by which they compromise cerebral microvascular integrity remain elusive. This study aimed to investigate the role of the NETs-AIM2 inflammasome axis in mediating endothelial damage and to explore the therapeutic potential of targeting this pathway. METHODS: A controlled cortical impact (CCI) mouse model was utilized to simulate TBI. NET formation was modulated pharmacologically using the peptidylarginine deiminase 4 (PAD4) inhibitor Cl-amidine or genetically via adenoviral overexpression of PAD4. BBB permeability, brain edema, and cerebral blood flow (CBF) were assessed using Evans Blue extravasation, wet-to-dry weight ratio, T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging, and laser speckle contrast imaging. Neurological function was evaluated via modified Neurological Severity Score (mNSS) and rotarod tests. Molecular mechanisms were dissected using Western blotting, immunofluorescence, and cell-type-specific co-localization analyses. RESULTS: TBI induced significant PAD4-dependent NET formation, peaking at day 3 post-injury, which temporally coincided with BBB breakdown and neurological deficits. Cl-amidine treatment effectively preserved tight junction proteins (zonula occludens-1, Occludin) and adherens junction protein (vascular endothelial-cadherin), reduced Evans Blue extravasation, attenuated brain edema and lesion volume, promoted CBF restoration, and improved mNSS scores and rotarod performance. Mechanistically, NETs acted as upstream danger signals that specifically triggered AIM2 inflammasome activation, which was predominantly localized in cerebral microvascular endothelial cells rather than glial cells. This endothelial-specific AIM2 activation subsequently initiated PANoptosis-a multifaceted cell death program characterized by simultaneous pyroptosis, necroptosis, and apoptosis-in the vascular endothelium. Pharmacological inhibition of AIM2 effectively suppressed all three death pathways and preserved BBB integrity. Adenoviral overexpression of PAD4 exacerbated endothelial PANoptosis, whereas AIM2 inhibition reversed these effects, establishing the causal relationship. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings demonstrate a pathogenic axis wherein TBI-induced NETs drive endothelial PANoptosis via specific activation of the AIM2 inflammasome in cerebral microvascular endothelial cells, leading to BBB failure. Targeting this signaling cascade represents a promising therapeutic strategy to protect the neurovascular unit and improve functional recovery after TBI.

papers.abstract_en: Spatially resolved transcriptomics (SRT) serves as a transformative technology for examining gene expression within tissue architecture. However, accurate spatial domain identification remains challenging due to the inherent data sparsity and the tendency of graph-based methods to over-smooth representations at tissue boundaries. To overcome these limitations, we propose DiST, a novel self-supervised tensor learning framework. Distinct from conventional approaches that rely on neighborhood propagation, DiST introduces a Semantically Aligned Ego-Network Tensor construction strategy. By stacking semantically similar ego-networks from the global context, we transform flat graph data into high-order tensor structures that preserve local heterogeneity. Furthermore, we employ a robust low-rank and sparse decomposition mechanism to separate a coherent component used for representation learning from sparse entrywise deviations associated with sequencing dropouts and technical artifacts. This decomposition yields sparsity-resilient representations that recover sharp tissue structures. Extensive experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that DiST outperforms representative methods in spatial clustering. Moreover, downstream biological validation on human breast cancer data confirms DiST's capability to uncover biologically meaningful molecular signatures and functional heterogeneity.

papers.abstract_en: Aqueous hybrid sodium-ion batteries hold promise as next-generation electrochemical storage due to intrinsic safety and low cost. However, they are limited by specific energy and cycle lifespans. Here, we unlock multielectron tellurium redox chemistry in the aqueous system by coupling in situ hypervalent oxidation with selenium solid-solution modulation. In a sodium acetate electrolyte, the Te4O92- ↔ Te ↔ Te2- sequence enables a highly reversible six-electron reaction distinct from conventional tellurium chemistry. Selenium withdraws electron density from neighbouring tellurium, promotes oxidation, stabilizes high-valence intermediates and accelerates Na⁺ diffusion. As a result, Te0.85Se0.15 delivers 95.8% utilization of the theoretical six-electron capacity (~1217 mAh g-1 at 0.1 A g-1) and operates for 2000 cycles at 10 A g-1. Furthermore, a pouch cell achieves an active-material-level specific energy of approximately 114.3 Wh kg-1 at 0.33 A g-1. These findings outline a practical route to high-energy, high-power, and intrinsically safe aqueous sodium/zinc hybrid batteries for grid-scale deployment.

papers.abstract_en: Coastal polynyas are recurring regions of open water within sea ice that serve as sea-ice factories, producing vast amounts of new ice relative to nearby sea-ice-covered regions. Their formation and persistence are commonly attributed to strong offshore winds, while the influence of waves on polynya dynamics remains largely unexplored. Using rare wave-buoy observations from the Vincennes Bay Polynya, we show that strong winds generate energetic waves capable of breaking surrounding sea ice from the inside-outward, contrasting with outside-inward breakup caused by Southern Ocean swells. Satellite records from 2003-2022 reveal that extreme wave-induced breakup events coincide with substantial reductions in sea-ice concentration that persist for at least one week, accompanied by increased transitions to active frazil ice. These findings demonstrate that locally generated waves impact polynya dynamics and reshape surrounding sea-ice conditions. As Antarctic coastal polynyas evolve under a changing climate, wave activity may become increasingly important in shaping their sea-ice conditions and evolution.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE/OBJECTIVES: With the emergence of radiotheranostics, radiation oncology practices are adapting to offer new radiopharmaceutical therapies (RPTs), while qualified medical physicists (QMPs) support these programs. However, RPT-specific medical physics training is variable, and heavily dependent on the clinical setting. QMPs may therefore be tasked with supporting RPT programs without adequate training in the subject matter. In 2025, the Nuclear Oncology Division of the Department of Radiation Oncology at Willis Knighton Cancer Center launched a first-of-kind, one-year Nuclear Oncology Physics Fellowship. Here, we detail our program structure and provide a framework for further expansion of nuclear oncology medical physics training. METHODS: The fellowship is offered in partnership with three institutions: a large, tertiary community cancer center (hub site), a radiopharmaceutical research institution encompassing GMP isotope and radiopharmaceutical production and clinical and pre-clinical imaging, and a medical physics consulting group. The curriculum is split into twelve rotations covering the core competencies outlined by major certifying bodies. Primary mentors hold board certifications in diagnostic, nuclear medicine, or therapeutic medical physics. RESULTS: The fellowship may be completed before or after physics residency training, and culminates in a final project, in which the trainee designs a mock theranostics department. The program was verified to meet current training requirements for board certification in nuclear medicine physics. At the time of writing, the program enrolled its first fellow (pre-residency) and recruited its second trainee (post-residency). CONCLUSION: The fellowship provides a pathway for QMPs to gain the necessary training to support new theranostics programs. The curriculum may be adapted to accommodate the interests of each trainee and extended to support individuals in other crucial professions within the theranostics space. Future development of RPT-specific training guidelines may influence adjustments to the curriculum and certification processes; however, the current model provides a robust template for necessary QMP training.

papers.abstract_en: PURPOSE: The overall goal of this study was to understand the landscape of newly awarded cancer survivorship-focused NIH career development (K) grants from FY2017 to FY2024. METHODS: Cancer survivorship-focused NIH career development (K) grants awarded from FY2017 to FY2024 were identified using a text mining algorithm of survivorship-relevant terms from the NIH Research, Condition, and Disease Categorization (RCDC) system and double coded for grant characteristics (e.g., study design, cancer type, primary focus, and primary outcomes). RESULTS: A total of 217 newly awarded NIH K grants from FY2017 to FY2024 were identified. The number of grants funded rose from 15 in FY2017 to 42 in FY2024. The largest percentage of grants used the K08 mechanism (40.1%); approximately half of the grants were awarded to principal investigators that had a Ph.D. only as their terminal degree. Nearly 43% had a primary research focus on late- or long-term effects; 34.1% had a care delivery focus. Fifty-nine percent of the grants were intervention studies; of these, almost all were pilot/feasibility studies (85.9%). CONCLUSIONS: Findings show a growth in the number of cancer survivorship-focused K grants funded from FY2017 to FY2024. While the primary focus of the grants has diversified over time, notable gap areas remain, including financial hardship and research in certain special survivor populations, including survivors of less common cancers and long-term cancer survivors. IMPLICATIONS FOR CANCER SURVIVORS: As the number of cancer survivors in the USA continues to grow, NIH-level support of early-career cancer survivorship investigators is critical.

papers.abstract_en: Electrospun nanofibers (ESNFs) have become a major focus of modern research given their adaptable architecture, extensive interface, and distinctive physicochemical characteristics, making them appropriate for varied applications such as catalysis and environmental cleanup, drug delivery (DD), tissue engineering (TE), sensing, actuation, and various energy-related technologies. As a result, electrospinning (ES) has emerged as a versatile manufacturing technique, driving intensive efforts to engineer nanofibrous structures specifically for biomedical purposes. Functionalization of ESNFs can be achieved by embedding functional agents or altering surface chemistry to introduce specific functionalities. This review discusses the fabrication methods, optimization techniques, and broad biomedical applications of modified ESNFs, emphasizing their key properties, including biocompatibility, degradability, and safety profile. The article outlines various strategies for creating and modifying ESNFs, followed by a comprehensive analysis of their applications in tissue regeneration, DD, wound repair, antimicrobial therapy, cancer diagnostics and treatment, and biosensing. By critically evaluating recent advances, highlighting future directions, and addressing ongoing challenges about ES, this review underscores the transformative potential of functionalized ESNFs as efficient and adaptable biomaterials for biomedical technologies.

papers.abstract_en: INTRODUCTION: We previously showed that human HMGB1 has anti-biofilm activity localized to a 97-amino-acid B-Box-derived peptide (mB Box-97), engineered with a C106S mutation to reduce HMGB1's proinflammatory properties while retaining anti-biofilm function. This peptide also suppresses NETosis by inhibiting neutrophil protein kinase C (PKC) activity. Here, we tested whether the anti-biofilm and anti-NETotic activities of mB Box-97 could be separated into distinct shorter peptides by constructing truncated variants containing Helix 1 of the B-Box (with the C106S mutation), with or without the A Box-B Box linker region, and by introducing mutations at key DNA-binding residues. METHODS: Anti-NETotic activity was assessed in human neutrophils, including peptide binding to PKC, effects on PKC activity, and downstream NADPH oxidase (NOX) activation, reactive oxygen species (ROS) generation, and NETosis. Biofilm disruption and bacterial growth effects were tested against pathogenic bacteria. RESULTS: Peptides combining the linker with Helix 1 and C106S significantly inhibited NETosis while preserving anti-biofilm activity, via PKC binding/inhibition, reduced NOX activation, and lower ROS. Removing the linker preserved anti-biofilm activity but abolished anti-NETotic activity, yielding a 29-amino-acid anti-biofilm-only peptide. Conversely, adding DNA-binding mutations to the linker-Helix 1 peptide abolished anti-biofilm activity while retaining anti-NETotic function. CONCLUSIONS: Anti-NETotic and anti-biofilm activities of HMGB1-derived peptides can be structurally separated: the linker plus Helix 1 are required for anti-NETotic activity, while Helix 1 alone suffices for anti-biofilm activity. These compact 42- and 29-amino-acid peptides are readily synthesizable, promising candidates for biofilm- and NET-mediated inflammatory diseases, and further support PKC as a target for NETosis inhibition.

papers.abstract_en: Protein delivery systems face persistent challenges, including low encapsulation efficiency, limited targeting ability, and lack of generalizability. Here, we propose a modular and programmable polysaccharide-based platform, enabling efficient encapsulation of a wide range of proteins, and tunable targeting across different cell types. The stepwise assembly applies tannic acid (TA) for protein surface stabilization. This rewires the encapsulation mechanism from unstable electrostatic binding to robust van der Waals-driven protein lock-in. The TA-protein complex can be encapsulated in an interchangeable polysaccharide nano-framework, exploiting the lectin-glycan recognition pattern to direct cell- and disease-specific targeting. The TA-Polysaccharide Encapsulation (TAPE) system robustly achieves > 85% encapsulation efficiency (EE) across a range of proteins, and tailoring the polysaccharide choice enables programmable targeting to distinct cell types. As a proof of concept, hirudin-loaded TAPE achieved targeted anticoagulant treatment in vivo. Overall, our work positions TAPE as a simple and generalizable platform that overcomes fundamental barriers in protein delivery, offering wide translational potential for protein-based therapies.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) for cecal lesions in proximity to the appendiceal orifice (L-PAO) is technically demanding and associated with risks of incomplete resection and post-ESD appendicitis. We aimed to assess the feasibility and safety of appendectomy-integrated laparoscopic and endoscopic cooperative surgery (A-LECS) as a novel organ-preserving strategy. METHODS: This retrospective, two-center study included four consecutive patients with L-PAO Type 3 lesions (extending into the appendix) treated with A-LECS between June 2024 and July 2025. The procedure consisted of underwater ESD combined with traction to achieve maximal intraluminal dissection, followed by immediate laparoscopic appendectomy and subsequent endoscopic closure of the cecal defect. RESULTS: Technical success was achieved in all cases without conversion to open surgery. The mean ESD procedure time was 116.5 minutes. No procedure-related adverse events, such as perforation, bleeding, or stump appendicitis, occurred. Pathological evaluation confirmed complete resection in all cases (3 SSLs, 1 intramucosal adenocarcinoma). No recurrence was observed in follow-up endoscopy. CONCLUSIONS: A-LECS may represent a feasible and safe organ-preserving strategy for challenging L-PAO Type 3 lesions that maintains oncological integrity and reduces the risk of post-procedural appendicitis.

papers.abstract_en: Climate change threatens decades of progress toward malaria elimination across the Asia Pacific. In recent years, reported cases have increased sharply in several regions, including Pakistan following the 2022 floods. However, current research and adaptation strategies have largely focused on gradual warming and shifting transmission seasons and may not fully capture acute operational disruptions in endemic settings. Here we examine how climate change influences malaria through cascading disruptions to health systems, population displacement and ecological change. As a multidisciplinary group of policymakers and researchers, we identify priority actions: integrating malaria control into disaster response, deploying adaptive vector control for displaced populations, strengthening cross-border data sharing, linking early warnings to anticipatory action, and incorporating land-use data into surveillance. Leveraging existing advances in climate policy, digital surveillance and community engagement will be critical. Sustaining elimination will require complementing long-term projections with preparedness for near-term system shocks.

papers.abstract_en: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) possess favorable biocompatibility and diverse biological functions, making them promising platforms for therapeutic delivery. However, realizing their full delivery potential requires precise engineering of EVs with tailored functionalities. By bridging chemical tools and biological systems, chemical biology provides a versatile toolkit for the modular engineering of EVs. Here, we provide a systematic overview of recent progress in chemical biology-enabled EV engineering, with an emphasis on three main strategies including protein engineering, nucleic acid engineering, and glycoengineering. In this review, we discuss the design principles of representative approaches and assess their practical utility and performance. Particular attention is given to the integration of orthogonal engineering strategies to coordinate multiple delivery functions within a single EV platform. We further discuss emerging opportunities in multi-specific vesicular antibody design and artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted engineering. By linking molecular engineering strategies with specific delivery requirements, this review provides a comprehensive chemical biology-based framework for the rational design of engineered EVs with tailored delivery functions.

papers.abstract_en: This narrative review highlights that tuberculosis (TB) treatment succeeds or fails at the regimen level, rather than based on individual drugs. The central challenge is to sustain effective multidrug pressure across a pathogen population in heterogeneous microenvironments. In drug-susceptible TB, rifampicin-based combinations achieve high cure rates; however, prolonged treatment duration, drug toxicity, and treatment interruptions drive resistance. In drug-resistant TB, newer agents like bedaquiline, nitroimidazoles, and repurposed linezolid enable shorter, all-oral regimens, yet durability depends on preventing resistance while maintaining effective exposure. Here, we review the available information on anti-TB drugs, concentrating on the physiological states of pathogen, resistance fitness landscapes, and regimen-level pharmacodynamics. These concepts are considered as complementary perspectives for understanding treatment response and directing future research. First, we map how drug classes distribute activity across pathogen physiological states, thereby establishing the need for mechanistic complementarity. Second, we conceptualize resistance as a constrained evolutionary outcome shaped by mutation supply and fitness costs, as illustrated by resistance to bedaquiline, pretomanid, and linezolid. Third, we integrate lesion pharmacokinetics and combination-response landscapes to demonstrate how spatial drug gradients and microenvironment-specific interactions can guide regimen prioritisation. These concepts are interpreted with WHO target regimen profiles to identify principles for protecting high-value core drugs as finite global assets.

papers.affiliation_highlight: Department of Midwifery and Reproductive Health, School of Nursing and Midwifery, Tehran University of Medical Sciences,…
papers.authors_conclusion: 本范围综述结果凸显，亟需在惩教医疗机构政策与实践层面进行系统性变革，以确保全球在押女性公平获得全面的生殖健康服务；战略规划、协同协调与针对性干预对于维护生殖正义、改善这一脆弱人群的健康结局至关重要。
papers.ai_note: 主题与本平台胸外科/胸部肿瘤业务无交集，属公共卫生与惩教健康领域，专科契合度评为0；为定性主题归纳，未报告任何效应量、患病率或置信区间，25项研究的地区分布、设计构成与异质性均未呈现，MMAT评价结果也未给出，无法据此判断证据强度；三大主题的提炼过程（编码、复核、一致性）信息不足；结论为规范性政策呼吁，超出综述本身可支持的推断范围。

pico.p: 全球在押育龄女性相关研究25项（纳入文献层面，非患者个体层面）
pico.ic: 无干预与对照设置；为文献范围梳理与主题归纳

papers.reason: 该文与胸部肿瘤诊疗、肺结节判读、围手术期决策均无关联，不能为任何胸科临床判断提供依据；仅在方法学层面可作为'范围综述+PRISMA-ScR+MMAT'流程的写作范本，或作为'特殊人群健康服务需求'类研究的设计参照，故临床与专科评分接近下限。
papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: The increasing female prisoner population worldwide highlights the urgent need for tailored reproductive healthcare services in correctional facilities. However, there remains a significant gap in comprehensively understanding and addressing the unique reproductive healthcare needs of incarcerated reproductive-aged women. AIM: This review aimed at mapping existing literature on the reproductive healthcare needs of incarcerated women worldwide. METHODS: This study employed a scoping review methodology following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses guidelines for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). A thorough analysis of 25 relevant studies was conducted. Quality appraisal of included studies performed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool. RESULTS: The analysis yielded three prominent themes: Comprehensive Preventive Health Services, Healthcare Provision, and Maternal Health Care Continuum. These themes underscore the critical importance of addressing infection control, providing psychological support, ensuring adequate maternal care, and promoting hygiene practices within correctional settings. CONCLUSION: The findings of this scoping review highlight the urgent need for systemic changes in correctional healthcare policies and practices to ensure equitable access to comprehensive reproductive healthcare services for incarcerated women globally. Strategic planning, collaborative coordination, and targeted interventions are essential to uphold reproductive justice and improve health outcomes for this vulnerable population.

papers.abstract_en: Early brain injury after subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH) is chiefly marked by neuronal apoptosis and neuroinflammation, while the principal regulating molecules have yet to be identified. RBM47 exhibited considerable upregulation in the cerebral cortex of SAH mice and hemoglobin (Hb)-induced primary cortical neurons. Knockdown of RBM47 with intracerebroventricular injection of small interfering RNA improved neurobehavioral scores (modified Garcia score and beam balance test), mitigated brain edema and SAH grade, and decreased the quantity of FJC-positive and TUNEL-positive neurons in the cortex. Furthermore, RBM47 knockdown suppressed the expression of apoptotic proteins, obstructed HMGB1 nuclear to cytoplasmic translocation, and reduced TNF-α and IL-6 concentrations. In vitro results further validated that RBM47 knockdown diminished Hb-induced neuronal apoptosis and neuroinflammation. The transcription factor EGR1 directly bound to the RBM47 promoter and transcriptionally stimulated RBM47. RBM47 enhanced PARP1 expression by binding to the 3'UTR of PARP1 mRNA. Co-immunoprecipitation demonstrated a connection between PARP1 and HMGB1, facilitating HMGB1 release. We conducted label-free proteomics analysis on primary neurons following PARP1 knockdown and Hb therapy. Differentially expressed proteins were enriched in ADP ribosylation, regulation of necroptosis, and the extrinsic apoptotic pathway. GSEA revealed a large negative enrichment of the neuronal apoptotic process, while pathways associated with mitochondrial activity exhibited highly significant positive enrichment. EGR1 transcriptionally stimulates RBM47, which then enhances HMGB1 release by upregulating PARP1, therefore facilitating neuronal death and inflammation following SAH. PARP1 knockdown alters the mitochondrial protein expression profile and inhibits apoptosis and necroptosis. Targeting the EGR1/RBM47/PARP1/HMGB1 axis may provide an innovative therapeutic approach for SAH.

papers.authors: Gao Y, He L, Hu X, Liu D, Zhou L, Sun H, Li X, Dai X et al.
papers.affiliation_highlight: Beijing Key Laboratory of High-Entropy Energy Materials and Devices, Beijing Institute of Nanoenergy and Nanosystems, Ch…
papers.results: 低电压区间电路效率约80%（初级电路90.9%，次级电路93.9%）；在1.87 V下电流密度5.19 A/m2、功率密度9.70 W/m2，较此前最佳工作提升近一个数量级；自供电制氢系统产气率达16.5 mL/(min·m2)；可驱动手机。
papers.authors_conclusion: 该工作突破了TENG与常规功率管理电路集成时低于5 V性能与效率显著退化的瓶颈，为物联网与工业场景中高效TENG供电装置建立了基础框架，弥合了能量采集技术与实际能量需求之间的差距。
papers.ai_note: 本文为材料/器件工程研究，与胸部肿瘤临床及呼吸疾病均无直接关联，不构成任何临床证据。摘要中“约80%电路效率”与“初级90.9%、次级93.9%”为不同层级口径（整机 vs 分级电路），摘要未说明80%的测量边界，易被混读；“nearly an order of magnitude improvement over best prior work”仅给出定性比较，未列出对照数值、测试条件一致性及统计检验；“record gas yield”为作者自述纪录，无第三方基准或误差范围；全文无置信区间、无统计学推断，重复次数与器件批次一致性未在摘要中体现，相关信息不足。

papers.abstract_en: Triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs) offer transformative potential for self-powered systems, yet their real-world applicability faces a key bottleneck as their performance and efficiency suffer dramatic degradation below 5 V that the operational threshold for most electronics when integrated with conventional power management circuits. Here, we overcome this limitation through the multi-stage buck strategy that synergistically combines dual-stage voltage conversion circuit with TENG's output characteristic by the Q-V curve, enabling precise voltage regulation at critical nodes. The strategy achieves approximately 80% circuit efficiency at the low-voltage range, with 90.9% in the primary circuit and 93.9% in the secondary circuit. Concurrently, the current and power density reach 5.19 A/m2 and 9.70 W/m2 at 1.87 V, which is nearly an order of magnitude improvement over best prior work. Demonstrated in self-powered hydrogen production system, this approach achieves a record gas yield of 16.5 mL/(min·m2), resolving the challenge of low-voltage inefficiency in self-powered systems. Additionally, it is capable of powering a mobile phone. Our work establishes a foundational framework for implementing efficient TENG-powered devices in Internet of Things networks and industrial applications, bridging the gap between energy harvesting technologies and actual energy demands.

papers.title_en: Community Pharmacists' Perspectives and Experiences of Deprescribing in Québec, Canada: Findings From a Survey.
papers.authors: Campeau Calfat A, Martin B, Sirois C
papers.affiliation_highlight: Faculty of Pharmacy, Université Laval, Quebec City, Quebec, Canada.
papers.results: 366 名受访者中，269 人（74%）为女性，282 人（77%）全职工作，223 人（61%）有临床干预时间，193 人（53%）从业不足 11 年；271 人（约四分之三）报告至少每月启动一次处方精简；去处方原因为副作用 273 人（75%）、患者要求 220 人（60%）；268 人（>70%）报告处方者通常接受建议；初次与随访咨询被系统性计费者分别为 183 人（50%）与 174 人（48%）；有专门临床时间及全职工作者中处方精简与计费实践更常见（均 p < 0.01）；计费主要障碍为培训不足 217 人（59%）、报销资格不确定 127 人（35%）、缺乏时间 112 人（31%）；整合软件为最常见促进因素 246 人（67%）

papers.ai_note: 仅通过社交媒体群组与通讯便利抽样，未报告应答率与受邀人数，样本代表性不明，自报数据存在社会期望偏倚；分析仅用描述性统计与单因素卡方检验，未对全职状态、临床时间等高度共线的因素做多因素校正，故 p < 0.01 的关联不能视为独立预测因素；"超过 70%"与"约四分之三"等表述未给出统一分母，与具体计数（268/271）并置时口径不清；与胸部肿瘤诊疗决策无直接关联。

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Community pharmacists in Quebec can bill for deprescribing. However, uptake remains low. We aimed to explore how community pharmacists perceive and engage in deprescribing. METHODS: Community pharmacists were invited to complete an online survey through a pharmacists' social media group and a newsletter. Data were analysed using descriptive statistics and univariate chi-square tests. RESULTS: Among 366 respondents, most were women (n = 269; 74%), worked full-time (n = 282; 77%), had time for clinical interventions (n = 223; 61%), while 53% (n = 193) had fewer than 11 years of experience. Three quarters (n = 271) reported initiating deprescribing at least monthly. Side effects (n = 273; 75%) and patients' requests (n = 220; 60%) were more common reasons for deprescribing. More than 70% (n = 268) reported that prescribers usually accepted recommendations. Initial and follow-up consultations were systematically billed by 50% (n = 183) and 48% (n = 174) of respondents, respectively. Deprescribing interventions and billing practices were more common among pharmacists with dedicated clinical time and those working full time (all p < 0.01). Main barriers to billing were insufficient training (n = 217; 59%), uncertainty about reimbursement eligibility (n = 127; 35%) and lack of time (n = 112; 31%). Integrated software was the most common facilitator (n = 246; 67%). CONCLUSION: Deprescribing was commonly reported among respondents and was often prompted by clinical concerns and patient requests. Billing uncertainties and time constraints remained important barriers, highlighting opportunities to better support deprescribing in community pharmacy.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: Carbapenem-resistant organisms are increasingly reported in clinical settings, yet the simultaneous detection of multiple carbapenemase genes within a single specimen remains rare. METHODS: Metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) were performed on a bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) sample from a patient with severe pneumonia. RESULTS: Four carbapenemase genes-bla AFM-1, bla NDM-1, bla IMP-1, and bla KPC-2-were simultaneously detected in a single specimen. Three carbapenem-resistant isolates were recovered: an ST11 K. pneumoniae carrying bla KPC-2 and virulence-associated genes, an S. algae strain with an assembly-based tandem chromosomal bla NDM-1 arrangement, and a P. stutzeri strain co-harboring bla AFM-1 and bla IMP-1. Genomic analysis revealed complex mobile genetic contexts associated with these resistance determinants. CONCLUSION: The coexistence of four carbapenemase genes within one clinical sample highlights the complexity of polymicrobial carbapenem resistance and underscores the importance of genomic surveillance.

papers.abstract_en: BACKGROUND: PCC is widely recognised as an important approach to supporting QoL in nursing homes. However, staff's ability to provide PCC may be influenced by leadership and working conditions. There is still limited knowledge of how staff themselves experience performing PCC to support residents' QoL in everyday nursing home care. The aim of this study was to explore staff experiences of providing PCC to support resident QoL and how their provision of PCC is influenced by leadership and staff working conditions. METHODS: A qualitative study design was used. Fifteen semi-structured interviews were conducted with 10 enrolled nurses and five nursing assistants working in nursing homes in four Swedish municipalities between February and May 2024. Data were analysed using qualitative conventional content analysis. RESULTS: An overarching theme, Creating everyday meaning despite challenges, was supported by three categories: Building human relationships in care, Connecting through communication and teamwork, and Overcoming obstacles for person-centred care. Meaningful relationships, attentiveness and tailored support were described as central to providing PCC and supporting residents' QoL. Communication and teamwork enabled staff to understand and respond to residents' individual needs, while leadership contributed by supporting staff and facilitating teamwork. Organisational barriers, including staffing shortages, time pressure, communication difficulties and limited leadership support, constrained staff members' ability to consistently provide PCC and support residents' QoL. CONCLUSIONS: Staff described a strong intrinsic commitment to providing PCC that supports residents' QoL. However, their ability to do so was shaped by leadership and organisational conditions. Enabling PCC in nursing homes therefore requires not only staff commitment, but also supportive leadership, adequate staffing and work environments that allow time, communication and continuity in care. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.

papers.abstract_en: Patient perspectives are highly important to ensure optimal patient care in hospitals or primary care settings. Clinical pharmacy services, in which clinical pharmacists provide direct patient care, are a relatively recent addition to healthcare and are increasing in scope and availability. In this focused narrative review, relevant qualitative studies describing patients' perspectives after the integration of clinical pharmacists into healthcare services were included. Patients described predominantly positive feedback, presented as facilitators. The facilitators described in studies were that patients felt safe, experienced clear communication and collaboration with pharmacists, increased their knowledge of medications, and appreciated pharmacists' time and availability. Occasionally, patients described challenges with the pharmacist or service, presented as barriers. The barriers were that patients were unfamiliar with the clinical pharmacists' role and services, lacked trust or experienced conflicting information, experienced a lack of patient-centredness, and some disagreed or had challenges with elements of the intervention. In conclusion, most perspectives represented positive facilitators that should be kept and protected in the future, with some barriers that can be overcome in the future for optimal patient care and development of clinical pharmacy services.

papers.abstract_en: Preeclampsia (PE) is a severe pregnancy-specific disorder and a leading cause of maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality. Although the traditional two-stage model links abnormal placentation to maternal endothelial dysfunction, it does not fully explain how placental stress is converted into persistent systemic inflammation. This review reframes the mitochondria-immune axis as a hierarchical and self-amplifying network in PE. In this model, placental hypoxia-reoxygenation, endoplasmic reticulum stress and anti-angiogenic stress act as initiating events that destabilize mitochondrial homeostasis in trophoblasts, endothelial cells and immune cells. Damaged mitochondria then release reactive oxygen species (ROS), mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) and other danger signals, which activate innate immune sensors, including the NLRP3 inflammasome, cGAS-STING, TLR9 and NF-kB pathways. These pathways induce IL-1β, TNF-α, type I interferon signaling, complement activation, neutrophil extracellular traps and macrophage/T-cell imbalance, which in turn aggravate mitochondrial injury and sustain a pathogenic feedback loop. We further distinguish the likely contribution of this axis across PE subtypes, including early-onset, late-onset, maternal, canonical and immunological PE. The review critically evaluates circulating mtDNA and mitochondria-related genes as biomarkers, emphasizing the effects of sample processing, vesicle-bound mtDNA, cellular contamination, gestational timing and assay choice. Therapeutic opportunities are discussed according to translational maturity, from clinically relevant supportive approaches and PE-tested preclinical interventions to extrapolated mitochondrial and immunopharmacological strategies. Overall, the mitochondria-immune axis provides a structured framework for subtype-aware biomarker development and mechanism-guided intervention in PE, while highlighting the need for standardized longitudinal cohorts and pregnancy-specific safety validation.
